text:
Dawson Mercer's season split in two on Oct. 23, when New Jersey sent him to Winnipeg as part of the return for Connor Hellebuyck, per NHL.com. He had not scored in 10 games with the Devils. With the Jets, he has found the net: all five of his goals came in his last ten games, two of them against his old team on Nov. 10.

He has 12 points in 23 games at about 16 minutes a night, with his ice time up 1.4 minutes lately. His total finishing is about even with his chances (5 goals on 4.82 expected goals, the quality of chances).

The recent hot run is mostly bounces, though. Over his last ten games he has seven points against about 5.3 expected at his ice time, while the chances on his own shots (2.2 expected goals) are no better than usual. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking shows he gets good passes to shoot off. Evolving-Hockey ranked him 176th of 401 forwards last season. A fresh start, a bigger role, and a scoring run that has outpaced the chances.
